content.text: No licence grant exists anywhere in this agreement. Submitting a needs_review finding without a redline.

input.quote: The Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
input.rationale: This is a securitization transfer and servicing agreement between the Issuer/Depositor and Cellco as Servicer, Marketing Agent and Custodian; it contains no licence grant of software, technology or other intellectual property to us. Searches for grant language, software/systems access, IP/trademark rights and any use rights returned nothing: the only occurrences of "licen[cs]e" are regulatory qualification representations (p0234, p0259, p0272) and the negative statement in Section 7.4 (p0346) that the Servicer is not obliged to provide, license or assign its servicing software or applications to a Successor Servicer. That negative statement is not a grant clause whose scope could be extended to affiliates on written notice or made transferable to an M&A successor; it is a transition/IP allocation term and, per the review plan, is assessed under IP/TRANSITION so it is not double-flagged here. Because there is no licensed subject matter under this contract, neither fallback element can be met and drafting a software licence grant into an ABS servicing agreement would insert a bargain the parties never made. Flagging for human review rather than proposing an inapposite insertion; if the deal team expects the Issuer or a Successor Servicer to receive rights in Cellco's servicing platform, that should be negotiated in the Section 7.4 transition provision.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
mappings.explanation: There is no licence grant in the agreement to which affiliate coverage could attach; the only licence-adjacent text (p0346) is an express disclaimer of any obligation to license servicing software, and no notice mechanic for extending licensed rights exists anywhere in the document.

mappings.element: The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
mappings.explanation: No licence exists to be transferred. Successor provisions (p0249, p0348) address assumption of this Agreement by a merger/acquisition successor of the Depositor or Servicer, not transfer of any licensed rights, so the element cannot be satisfied or drafted without inventing a licence grant.
